text: れんしゅうで　つかれた　からだには　やっぱり　おんせんが　きくぜ！

structure.jp: れんしゅうで　つかれた　からだには
structure.en: for a body tired out from training

structure.jp: やっぱり　おんせんが　きくぜ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: れんしゅうで　つかれた　からだ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that...' in English. れんしゅうで　つかれた　からだ = 'a body that got tired from training'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で here shows what caused something: 'from' or 'because of'. れんしゅうで = 'from training'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes the statement at the listener, like 'I tell ya'. きくぜ = 'it works, I tell ya'.
